notes:
Fixed
• Long edits no longer freeze on "Saving project…". Solis no longer saves in the middle of an edit; the project is saved once, at the very end, and Solis does not wait on Premiere's save dialog.
• Imports no longer hang on "Import Files…". Sounds and music are imported one file at a time, so Premiere stays responsive.
• "Edit stopped" no longer appears when Premiere is busy (saving, importing, a dialog open) or briefly shows another project. Solis waits until your project is back and continues the edit.
• If Premiere stays busy for a long time, the edit is paused with its progress saved. Open the project in Premiere and choose Resume Edit to continue where it stopped.
